reason: The cited evidence (E1) only states that Al-based HEAs have low densities and that W/Re-containing HEAs are studied for high-temperature properties; it does not provide any evidence that Al additions induce B2 precipitates, that such precipitates improve high-temperature strength, or that a 2–10 at% Al addition yields a 20–30% improvement while preserving ductility. The key mechanistic and quantitative premises are entirely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Al-based HEAs have low densities and are studied for aircraft engines

Al addition can induce B2-type precipitates in refractory HEAs
